article.title: How might game theory shed light on Trump talking to Kim?
article.excerpt: That is the topic of my latest Bloomberg column , they chose a nice photo. Here is an excerpt: If North Korea and the U.S. simply talk, and nothing comes of it, that raises the status of Kim Jong Un, who then would keep improving his missiles anyway. So if the U.S. goes ahead with the talks, you might rationally infer that the risk of war has gone up. Furth
